english.title: Contravene a licence to admit spectators
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), were a responsible person when a term or condition of a licence to admit spectators was contravened, in that **(..SPECIFY THE CONTRAVENTION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 10(13) and (15) of the Football Spectators Act 1989.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
contravened a term or condition
of a licence issued under section 10 of the Football Spectators Act 1989
to admit spectators

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Section 10(14) provides that where a person is charged with an offence under this subsection it shall be a defence to prove (a) that the contravention took place without his consent; and (b) that he took all reasonable precautions and exercised all due diligence to avoid the commission of such an offence.
(ii) Section 1(9) of that Act defines a responsible person in relation to any designated football match at any premises if he is a person concerned in the management of the premises or in the organisation of the match.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant was a responsible person when a term or condition of a licence to admit spectators was contravened, in that **(..SPECIFY THE CONTRAVENTION..).

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
